notes: cics-crucible pseudo-conversational / pc-return-immediate (Apache-2.0 corpus, owner OK 2026-10-31 for the ladder, #6072): the program a RETURN IMMEDIATE attaches (PCIMMB): the first stage returns for the next ENTER, the second ends. Each scenario is one task; the crucible's multi-turn flows are restated one scenario per leg, each carrying the COMMAREA or channel the previous leg returned. The oracle is GnuCOBOL plus the stub, not the crucible's hand-written logs.

scenarios.name: stage-1
scenarios.why: CA-STAGE 1: logged, stage set to 2, RETURN TRANSID(PC52) with the COMMAREA

scenarios.name: short-calen-3
scenarios.why: EIBCALEN 3, shorter than the 8-byte layout: the area is cut to the caller's length (kills the exactCommarea / calen < length mutants)

scenarios.name: stage-1-hex-short
scenarios.why: a 5-byte caller area (stage 1, text ABCD): shorter than DFHCOMMAREA

scenarios.name: wq1-invreq
scenarios.why: first WRITEQ TS answers INVREQ: condition() abend path

scenarios.name: stage-x
scenarios.why: stage other than 1 or 2 takes the ELSE

scenarios.name: stage-1-hex-equal-8
scenarios.why: an 8-byte caller area, exactly the layout: the write-back on the RETURN passes stage 2

scenarios.name: stage-1-hex-long-15
scenarios.why: a 15-byte caller area, longer than the 8-byte layout: byte 0 still becomes stage 2 on the RETURN (#9116)

scenarios.name: stage-1-hex-long-120
scenarios.why: a 120-byte caller area, far longer than the layout: byte 0 still becomes stage 2 on the RETURN (#9116)
